meta.title: Glossary of terms — Middle-earth world
meta.description: A glossary of key terms from the world of Middle-earth — Eru, Valar, Maiar, Númenor, Rings of Power, Mordor, Rohan, Gondor and others.

description: A glossary of key terms from the world of Middle-earth — Eru, Valar, Maiar, Númenor, Rings of Power, Mordor, Rohan, Gondor and others.
title: Glossary
subtitle: Terms that will help you find your way through Middle-earth.
intro_pre: This glossary explains key terms that recur in the Middle-earth world section and in The Lord of the Rings event. Some terms are Tolkien’s, others we use within our year’s game conception — the tags
alert_lore: Lore isn’t mandatory. This page helps those who want to understand their armies more deeply. For the participation itself, the rules, registration and practical information are what matters.
footer_note: We add to the glossary gradually. We describe terms in our own words, without direct quotations from Tolkien’s books.
lang_notice: The full glossary descriptions are currently in Czech. Translations of the entries themselves will follow in the next update.
